summary: Targeted psql query export authorization for customer data rectification
description:
Issue summary:
Customer support (internal case 79321) requested a focused extract of rows tied to a single customer email for a SAR/rectification flow. Legal requires a verifiable, auditable export that preserves only the fields necessary for the rectification and a detailed chain-of-custody.

Impact:
- Customer data access required for compliance; delay risks regulatory SLA breach.
- Request is scoped to a small number of records (estimated < 50 rows) but lives in production psql replicas that contain wider PII.

Environment:
- prod-us-east (read-only replica cluster rdb-replica-03)

Requested action:
- Approve a time-limited, scoped psql query export performed by a privileged ops engineer to an S3 bucket with server-side encryption and customer-keyed KMS.
- Deliver a redacted CSV containing only allowed columns (customer_id, canonical_email, request_timestamp, rectification_detail) and a separate audit manifest containing query hash, run metadata, and operator identity.

Required controls (proposed):
1) Just-in-time elevated role for one operator (Arjun Patel) valid for 2 hours.
2) Use a read-only SQL view that restricts columns and applies deterministic redaction for high-risk fields.
3) Export to timeboxed S3 path with SSE-KMS, bucket policy locked to support-exports account.
4) Redaction verification by Privacy SME (Lena Ortiz) before handing artifact to Legal.
5) Full session recording (kubectl/session and psql audit) and checksum written to confluence runbook.

Steps to reproduce / runbook (proposed):
- Create scoped read-only view: prod_ops.create_rectification_view(customer_email)
- JIT grant: iam/grant-temporary-role --user arjun.p --duration 2h --scope view:rectification_view
- Execute parameterized psql query with --output-csv to s3://support-exports/16032026/INT-814159-<timestamp>.csv
- Run redaction-verify script and produce manifest.json (sha256 checksums + operator id)

Logs / evidence to capture:
- psql audit logs (session ID), S3 write logs, KMS access logs, temporary role grant event ID, Slack thread #support-privacy link.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10: Initial triage by Maya - confirmed minimal row count. Customer consent doc (case 79321) attached to internal CS record.
2026-03-11: Infrastructure check by Arjun - replica rdb-replica-03 healthy, no major lag; existing export SOP covers large exports but not microscopic, timeboxed exports tied to legal SARs.
2026-03-11: Privacy SME (Lena Ortiz) requested deterministic redaction function to mask middle name/email tokens; suggested two-person review before release.
2026-03-12: Security (Priya Rao) reviewed and requested explicit KMS key ARN and S3 bucket policy snippet; suggested adding HMAC of CSV to manifest for later verification.
Hypothesis: Safe, auditable export achievable with temporary role + view + redaction script; main risk is accidental inclusion of extra columns if view definition is wrong.
